main.description: A maintainer's approval of a record in a package's or organization's repository: a release, or a change to a maintainers, members or team record. It is written to the maintainer's own repository. Its record key is the SHA-256 hash of the subject's AT-URI, a space and its CID, in lowercase base32 without padding, so it can be fetched without listing records.

entries.description: The private entries the attestation relies on, revealed: the maintainer's own in a team, an organization or a maintainers record that lists commitments.

approval.description: A WebAuthn assertion by one of the maintainer's approval keys over the subject's CID.

clientDataJSON.description: Its challenge is the subject's CID.
